description.text:
The Impact You'll Make
Join Lam as an IT Engineer and play a key role in supporting and advancing IT infrastructure across Taiwan sites. You'll be responsible for network operations, unified communications, server infrastructure, and deployment projects that enable secure and scalable business operations. Working with global and local teams, you'll help deliver technology solutions that drive operational excellence and business growth.
What You'll Do
✓ Network Operations & Support
- Plan and coordinate network installations, upgrades, and migration activities across office locations.
- Lead switch replacement projects and deployment of standard network infrastructure.
- Coordinate with vendors to manage installation, migration, and implementation activities.
- Ensure network equipment (switches, wireless access points, etc.) is delivered and ready according to project timelines.
- Support office relocations, expansions, and temporary site network implementations.
- Perform network testing, validation, and troubleshooting after deployment.
- Minimize service disruption through proactive planning and off-hours implementation when required.
- Work closely with Network and Security teams to ensure stable connectivity and compliance.
✓ Unified Communications (UC) Support
- Deploy, configure, and support enterprise communication solutions, including:
- Microsoft Teams
- Teams Phone System
- Teams Rooms
- VoIP / Telephony Systems
- Video Conferencing & AV Solutions
- Troubleshoot voice, video, messaging, and collaboration platform issues.
- Provide Level 2 / Level 3 support for UC-related incidents and service requests.
- Support new office and facility deployments for UC infrastructure.
- Coordinate with vendors for equipment procurement, installation, and maintenance.
- Collaborate with global UC teams to execute projects and resolve complex issues.
- Ensure high availability and performance of communication platforms.
✓ Server & Infrastructure Management
- Manage and maintain physical and virtual server environments.
- Perform server provisioning, patch management, system upgrades, and performance tuning.
- Maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes.
- Support data center operations, hardware installations, and rack deployment activities.
- Monitor system performance and proactively resolve infrastructure-related issues.
- Ensure system reliability, security, and operational stability.
✓ Infrastructure Projects & Deployment
- Participate in IT infrastructure projects for:
- New office deployments
- Facility expansions
- Technology refresh initiatives
- Infrastructure modernization programs
- Support the deployment of network, server, and unified communication infrastructure.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Security, Cloud, Workplace Services, and Facilities.
- Coordinate with external vendors to ensure successful project delivery.
- Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge-sharing materials.
Who We're Looking For
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering
- Minimum 5 years of relevant IT infrastructure experience
- Experience supporting enterprise IT environments and infrastructure operations.
Preferred Qualifications
Strong knowledge of:
- TCP/IP
- DNS
- DHCP
- LAN/WAN
- VPN
- Wireless Networking
Experience with:
- Microsoft Teams
- Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR)
- VoIP / Telephony Solutions
Hands-on experience administering:
- Microsoft 365
- Windows Server
- Virtualization Platforms
Familiarity with:
- ServiceNow or other ITSM platforms
- Infrastructure monitoring and management tools
✓ Soft Skills
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication in English and stakeholder management skills.
- Comfortable working with global teams across different time zones.
